Nora (CS): Quick note 11 I put together a tiny handoff cheat for low-touch accounts: micro-warmup, lightweight batching, and an emergency stream fallback. Wanted to get eyes before I add it to the CSM toolkit.

Ethan (SE): send it here pls

Nora (CS): paste below. Purpose: give CSMs a 60s checklist + one-liner curl and a customer-safe fallback note.

Nora (CS): Micro-warmup checklist (for accounts <10req/min): 1) Run micro-prefill curl 2x spaced 1m apart; TTL=900s. 2) Enable on-demand batching (80ms or 5 reqs). 3) Watch `cs.health.prefill.fail` for 10m.

Ethan (SE): Micro-prefill curl (copyable):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-open-6b","prompt":"[micro_warmup] prime","max_tokens":6}'
```

Leila (SRE): Metric hooks: emit `micro.prefill.attempt`, `micro.prefill.success`, `micro.batch.flush_count`, `micro.stream.fallback`. Tag: tenant_id, env. Alert: if success rate < 80% for 15m.

Omar (PM): Renewal-risk signals for CSMs to flag: repeated prefill failures (>4 in 72h), stream fallback >3/day, or batch flush ratio drop >25% W/W. That should trigger an enablement outreach.

Nora (CS): Customer-facing fallback note (short):

"Hi — were seeing intermittent streaming instability and have temporarily routed your workspace to a stable, non-streaming mode to keep responses reliable. No action needed; well follow up within 1 hour with an update. Reply if youd like a quick test command to run."

Ethan (SE): Troubleshooting steps for CSMs (paste into chat): 1) confirm API key & scopes 2) run the micro-prefill curl and paste the raw response 3) include last 3 sanitized logs below.

Leila (SRE): Sanitized sample logs to request:
```log
[2026-05-02T12:08:10Z] tenant=acme micro_prefill=ok ttl=900 backend=g2
[2026-05-02T12:08:11Z] tenant=acme batch=flush size=4 latency_ms=74 route=prefer_latency
[2026-05-02T12:10:22Z] tenant=acme stream=fallback reason=kv_miss count=1
```

Nora (CS): Internal playbook step: if renewal-risk=yellow, schedule 30-min enablement + offer a warmup window (engineers can run a guided prefill). Add to account healthcard.

Omar (PM): Add a tiny QA: ask customer to run curl and paste the token_count field so CSMs can verify responses quickly.

Leila (SRE): ETA on dashboard widgets for these micro metrics? I can add a staging tile today and prod tomorrow. Also adding an internal `cs_escalation` tag when alerts fire.

Nora (CS): Perfect. Ill fold this into a one-pager and ping the CSM list after staging tile is up. Thanks.

ops-bot: Reminder: cs-hourly-check at 14:00 UTC — agenda includes micro warmup doc review.

Ethan (SE): tiny follow: for mobile clients recommend 150ms batch window to trade latency for battery. Mark as mobile-specific.

Nora (CS): noted and added. closing for now unless objections.

Leila (SRE): no objections.

Omar (PM): looks good from PM.
